primary.title: Physics and Philosophy: The Revolution in Modern Science
primary.author: Werner Heisenberg
primary.rationale: Heisenberg's reflections on the philosophical implications of quantum mechanics, offering direct insight into his thought process and scientific worldview.

primary.title: Der Teil und das Ganze: Gespräche im Umkreis der Atomphysik
primary.author: Werner Heisenberg
primary.rationale: A collection of conversations and essays by Heisenberg, providing personal accounts and discussions on the development of quantum physics and his role in it.

primary.title: The Physical Principles of the Quantum Theory
primary.author: Werner Heisenberg
primary.rationale: An early and foundational exposition of quantum theory by one of its principal architects, presenting his direct scientific contributions.

secondary.title: Heisenberg's Uncertainty Principle: A Philosophical Study
secondary.author: David C. Cassidy
secondary.rationale: A comprehensive scholarly work by a noted historian of science, analyzing the scientific and philosophical impact of Heisenberg's uncertainty principle.

secondary.title: Quantum Mechanics, German Physics, and the Atomic Bomb: The Heisenberg Controversy
secondary.author: Mark Walker
secondary.rationale: An academic article that delves into the complex historical context of Heisenberg's work during World War II, particularly his involvement in the German atomic bomb project.

secondary.title: Werner Heisenberg: A Life in Physics
secondary.author: David C. Cassidy
secondary.rationale: A detailed biography that explores Heisenberg's scientific achievements, personal life, and the broader historical and philosophical context of his career.

suggestions.notes: Primary sources are primarily available through Internet Archive, reflecting the nature of scientific texts from this era. Secondary sources focus on scholarly analysis of his work and its historical context, with a preference for academic books and articles published after 1976.
